coreMemory.english: n. the way a person or thing acts
coreMemory.structure: change behavior /tʃeɪndʒ bɪˈheɪvjər/（改变行为）；positive behavior /pɑzətɪv bɪˈheɪvjər/（积极行为）；human behavior /hjumən bɪˈheɪvjər/（人类行为）；pattern of behavior /pætɚn ʌv bɪˈheɪvjər/（行为模式）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use behavior with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of behavior in context；❌ translate behavior word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “change behavior”

commonErrors.right: check the countability of behavior in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv bɪˈheɪvjər ɪn kɑntɛkst/
